messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: algebraic optimization certifying area lower bounds via semidefinite relaxation

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square has minimum triangle area exactly 1/224, achieved by placing points at the intersections of a 7-by-7 grid restricted to coordinates {i/7 : i=0,...,6} × {j/7 : j=0,...,6} selected so that every selected triple avoids collinearity on grid lines, and this value is certified by a semidefinite relaxation of the area polynomial whose dual certificate proves no configuration of 13 points in [0,1]² can exceed 1/224."}
